method: Actual isolated WordPress controller/verifier/state execution with explicitly simulated WP HTTP transport. No final production URL or live remote distribution was tested.

checks.name: Only HTTPS URLs in the embedded repository allowlist are accepted
Empty release index produces no fake download or activation fetch
Trusted download starts without fetching until an explicit step
One part per request verifies and advances persisted state
Transport requests preserve TLS verification and streaming bounds
Resuming an already verified exact archive avoids a second download
Redirect outside trusted release hosts is rejected
Incorrect trusted-index SHA-256 rejects the downloaded archive
Wrong expected part ID is rejected before extraction/registration
